description: Raw queries retain the lower category after admission selects the higher option. Flags and action ranking do not change those answers (engine §2.1 and §6.1).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution leftmost-longest #·high, lazy
%rule text $q:query %conditions ($q.parse(low) ∧ $q.onward.parse(low …) ∧ L ⊆ $q.parse(low).tags)

%rule query :: ∅ | (high ≻ low)

%rule high :: H | (X Y)
               

%rule low :: L | (X Y)
